warlock.openings: just cast, so it can't cast again yet

demon.openSides: left is open; right is near the arena edge

incomingToDemon.cloakCanBlock: yes, if it cloaks now (switching to fire costs no time)

state.round: round 2 of 5; warlock leads 1–0; demon ahead on health

demon_move.instructions: How should the demon move next? Keep away from the edge, where dodges run out.

criteria.advance: Walk toward the warlock. Right when `between.distance` is far, or `round` says the demon is ahead on health, or `warlock.health` is critical.
criteria.back_off: Walk away from the warlock. Right when `between.distance` is close, `demon.health` is critical, or most spells are in `demon.onCooldown`. Wrong when `demon.position` is near the edge.
criteria.strafe_left: Sidestep to the demon's left. Right when `between.warlockAim` is straight at or near the demon, or something is in `between.incomingToDemon`, and `demon.openSides` says left is open.
criteria.strafe_right: Sidestep to the demon's right. Right when `between.warlockAim` is straight at or near the demon, or something is in `between.incomingToDemon`, and `demon.openSides` says right is open.
criteria.hold: Stand still. Right when `between.distance` is mid and nothing is incoming, or while a cloak that blocks what is incoming is up.

demon_spell.instructions: Which spell should the demon carry? It casts only the carried spell, and its cloak blocks only that element. Fire beats frost, frost beats earth, earth beats fire: an attack hits 1.5× harder on a mage carrying what it beats (`counters` works this out).

criteria.fire: Carry fire: a slow orb whose splash and burn still catch a late dodge. Right when `counters.warlockWeakTo` is fire and fire is ready, or to cloak against incoming fire. Wrong when `counters.riskyForDemonToCarry` is fire, unless cloaking. Wrong for casting when `counters.warlockCloakBlocks` is fire.
criteria.frost: Carry frost: the fastest shot; a hit freezes the warlock for about a second, long enough for an earthspike to land. Right when `counters.warlockWeakTo` is frost and frost is ready, or to cloak against incoming frost. Wrong when `counters.riskyForDemonToCarry` is frost, unless cloaking. Wrong for casting when `counters.warlockCloakBlocks` is frost.
criteria.earth: Carry earth: the heaviest hit, along a line after a short charge that roots the demon; best when the warlock is frozen, rooted or standing still. Right when `counters.warlockWeakTo` is earth and earth is ready, or to cloak against incoming earth. Wrong when `counters.riskyForDemonToCarry` is earth, unless cloaking. Wrong for casting when `counters.warlockCloakBlocks` is earth.

demon_act.instructions: You control `demon`, a mage dueling `warlock` in a round arena; a round is won by bringing the other to zero health (`round` has the score). What should the demon do right now? A dash keeps a raised cloak up and breaks off an earthspike charge.

criteria.cast: Cast at the warlock. Right when `demon.canCast` starts with now or in a moment and nothing in `between.incomingToDemon` is imminent. Best when `warlock.openings` is not none, `warlock.status` says frozen or rooted, or `counters.demonHasWarlockWeaknessReady` is yes. A warlock cloak is an opening, not a reason to hold back: it stops only `counters.warlockCloakBlocks` and the warlock can't cast behind it. Wrong when `counters.warlockCloakBlocks` is the spell named in `demon.canCast`.
criteria.cloak: Raise the cloak and hold it. Right when an item in `between.incomingToDemon` has `cloakCanBlock` starting with yes. Also right before a shot, when `between.warlockAim` is straight at the demon and `warlock.carrying` is frost (too fast to cloak after the cast); the cloak then guards against `warlock.carrying`. Wrong when every incoming item says too late.
criteria.dash_left: Dash to the demon's left. Right when an item in `between.incomingToDemon` arrives imminent or in about half a second and its `cloakCanBlock` does not start with yes, and `demon.openSides` says left is open.
criteria.wait: Keep moving, don't cast. Right when nothing is incoming and `demon.canCast` does not start with now.

demon_aim.instructions: If the demon casts now, where should it aim?

criteria.straight_at_warlock: Aim where the warlock is now. Right when `warlock.movement` is standing still or `warlock.status` says rooted or frozen.
criteria.lead_warlock_movement: Aim ahead of the warlock. Right when `warlock.movement` is walking, strafing or dashing.
